views.name: publications_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "publication_number" AS publication_number,
  "application_number" AS application_number,
  "country_code" AS country_code,
  "kind_code" AS kind_code,
  "application_kind" AS application_kind,
  "application_number_formatted" AS application_number_formatted,
  "pct_number" AS pct_number,
  "family_id" AS family_id,
  "publication_date" AS publication_date,
  "filing_date" AS filing_date,
  "grant_date" AS grant_date,
  "priority_date" AS priority_date,
  "title_localized" AS title_localized,
  "abstract_localized" AS abstract_localized,
  "claims_localized" AS claims_localized,
  "description_localized" AS description_localized,
  "inventor_harmonized" AS inventor_harmonized,
  "assignee_harmonized" AS assignee_harmonized,
  "ipc" AS ipc,
  "cpc" AS cpc,
  "uspc" AS uspc,
  "entity_status" AS entity_status,
  "art_unit" AS art_unit
FROM PATENTS_GOOGLE.PATENTS_GOOGLE.PUBLICATIONS
views.description: Canonical, cleaned projection of PUBLICATIONS with commonly-used identifiers, dates normalized as integers, and key VARIANT fields exposed for downstream JSON access. Use this as the base publications catalog for joins, filtering, and aggregations. | Use for: List publications by family, country, or date ranges; Join publications to abstracts/embeddings or disclosures; Filter publications by assignee/inventor or classification present in VARIANT fields

views.name: abs_emb_by_publication
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "publication_number" AS publication_number,
  "title" AS title,
  "title_translated" AS title_translated,
  "abstract" AS abstract,
  "abstract_translated" AS abstract_translated,
  "cpc" AS cpc_variant,
  "cpc_low" AS cpc_low_variant,
  "cpc_inventive_low" AS cpc_inventive_low_variant,
  "top_terms" AS top_terms,
  "similar" AS similar,
  "url" AS url,
  "country" AS country,
  "publication_description" AS publication_description,
  "cited_by" AS cited_by,
  "embedding_v1" AS embedding_v1
FROM PATENTS_GOOGLE.PATENTS_GOOGLE.ABS_AND_EMB
grain: publication_number (one row per publication's abstract/embedding record)
views.description: Normalized ABS_AND_EMB rows keyed by publication_number exposing text, country and embedding variant for downstream vector or text analysis. Use when you need abstracts, titles, languages or embedding payloads aligned to publications. | Use for: Retrieve text or embeddings for search or similarity tasks; Join embedding vectors to publication metadata; Analyze CPC arrays stored in VARIANT for classification-level counts

views.name: disclosures_by_family
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "family_id" AS family_id,
  "record_id" AS record_id,
  "disclosure_event" AS disclosure_event,
  "sso" AS sso,
  "patent_owner_harmonized" AS patent_owner_harmonized,
  "patent_owner_unharmonized" AS patent_owner_unharmonized,
  "date" AS disclosure_date,
  "standard" AS standard,
  "committee_project" AS committee_project,
  "tc_name" AS tc_name,
  "sc_name" AS sc_name,
  "wg_name" AS wg_name,
  "licensing_commitment" AS licensing_commitment,
  "copyright" AS copyright,
  "blanket_type" AS blanket_type,
  "blanket_scope" AS blanket_scope,
  "third_party" AS third_party,
  "reciprocity" AS reciprocity,
  "serial_cleaned" AS serial_cleaned,
  "pub_cleaned" AS pub_cleaned
FROM PATENTS_GOOGLE.PATENTS_GOOGLE.DISCLOSURES_13
grain: record_id (one row per disclosure event record)
views.description: Event-level disclosures per family providing record identifiers, event type and date. Useful to filter or join disclosure events to publication families. Keep at event grain to allow aggregation later. | Use for: Find disclosures for a given family or date range; Aggregate disclosure counts per family or owner; Join disclosure events to publications via family_id

views.name: cpc_definition_flat
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "symbol" AS symbol,
  "status" AS status,
  "level" AS level,
  "titleFull" AS title_full,
  "titlePart" AS title_part_variant,
  "definition" AS definition_variant,
  "parents" AS parents_variant,
  "children" AS children_variant,
  "dateRevised" AS date_revised,
  "glossary" AS glossary_variant
FROM PATENTS_GOOGLE.PATENTS_GOOGLE.CPC_DEFINITION
views.description: Flat projection of CPC_DEFINITION preserving symbol, status, level and textual title fields. Use when resolving CPC codes to human-readable titles or hierarchy level. | Use for: Lookup CPC symbol -> title or level; Join classification arrays from publications/abs to CPC metadata; Filter CPCs by status or level for taxonomy-based analyses

views.name: pubs_with_abs_join
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.publication_number AS publication_number,
  p.family_id AS family_id,
  p.country_code AS country_code,
  p.publication_date AS publication_date,
  p.filing_date AS filing_date,
  p.grant_date AS grant_date,
  p.assignee_harmonized AS assignee_harmonized,
  p.inventor_harmonized AS inventor_harmonized,
  a.title AS title,
  a.abstract AS abstract,
  a.embedding_v1 AS embedding_v1,
  a.cpc_variant AS abs_cpc_variant,
  a.cpc_low_variant AS abs_cpc_low_variant
FROM publications_core p
LEFT JOIN abs_emb_by_publication a
  ON p.publication_number = a.publication_number
grain: publication_number (one row per publication, with ABS_AND_EMB if available)
views.description: Denormalized join of publications to ABS_AND_EMB at publication_number grain. Useful when analyses need metadata and text/embeddings together. Be aware join is 1:1 or 1:0 depending on ABS_AND_EMB coverage. | Use for: Compute text-based similarity for publications with metadata; Filter publications by assignee and analyze their abstracts/embeddings; Export publication text+metadata for downstream ML

views.name: latest_disclosure_per_family
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.family_id AS family_id,
  d.record_id AS record_id,
  d.disclosure_event AS disclosure_event,
  d.sso AS sso,
  d.patent_owner_harmonized AS patent_owner_harmonized,
  d.disclosure_date AS disclosure_date,
  d.standard AS standard,
  d.licensing_commitment AS licensing_commitment,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.family_id ORDER BY d.disclosure_date DESC NULLS LAST) AS disclosure_rank
FROM disclosures_by_family d
grain: family_id, record_id (one row per disclosure event with rank; use disclosure_rank = 1 to get latest-per-family)
views.description: For each family_id, returns the latest disclosure event row based on disclosure_date. Useful to join a single most-recent disclosure to publications while avoiding multiplicative joins. | Use for: Attach latest disclosure info to publications by family_id; Find families missing recent disclosures; Aggregate latest licensing commitments per family

views.name: family_publication_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  family_id AS family_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT publication_number) AS publication_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT country_code) AS country_count,
  MIN(publication_date) AS first_publication_date,
  MAX(publication_date) AS last_publication_date
FROM publications_core
GROUP BY family_id
views.description: Aggregate count of publications per family_id with optional breakdowns by country_code and earliest/latest publication_date. Useful for family-level analyses and de-duplicating counts across publications. | Use for: How many publications are in each family?; Which families span multiple countries or have long publication timelines?; Join family-level metrics to disclosures or assignees
